post.title: Stock futures did a U-turn after the midterms. Here's why
post.ig:
Midterm night: Dow futures sank, then flipped up 724 points by 6:30 AM ET.
The AP projects Democrats will win both the House and the Senate after Tuesday's midterms.
Nasdaq 100 futures hit 27,616, their lowest since July 30, then bounced to 28,546 by 6:30 AM ET, about 930 points.
Solar, hospital stocks and gold rose premarket; Tesla, SpaceX and defense stocks fell. CNBC found the S&P 500 was higher a year after each of the last 11 midterms (1982-2022), but that's the past, not a forecast.
Sources: CNBC, Associated Press via CNBC (Nov 4, 2026).
